title: config/knip-entries.json
description: What the repository adds to knip.json, the copy of kit: the entry files that make runs outside its layout entries and the system tools of the repository that its scripts spawn, each with its reason. make lint-ts runs knip with knip.json and these additions (scripts/kit/lint-ts.mts).

entries.description: Each entry glob, relative to the root, with the reason that it is an entry, such as the make target that runs it.

binaries.description: Each system tool of the repository that its scripts or tests spawn and no npm package provides, such as Apple container, with the reason; knip ignores it after the ignoreBinaries of knip.json, which name the runtimes that polyspec pins.
